rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PAETE HANDICRAFT RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING COVERAGE FOR THE TREATMENT OF INFERTILITY IN ANY GROUP HEALTH PLAN OR HEALTH INSURANCE
rows.title_short: Family Building Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Family Building Act of 2008.\" Directs group health plan and health insurance issuers offering health insurance coverage for obstetrical services to include coverage for treatment of infertility thereby making it possible for low and middle income families to avail of the technology of fertility therapy technology.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EVALUATION OF PUBLIC AND PRIVATE PROGRAMS IN ORDER TO REDUCE THE RATE OF TEENAGE PREGNANCY
rows.title_short: Teenage Pregnancy Reduction Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Teenage Pregnancy Reduction Act of 2008.\" Defines the term \"programmatic approaches\" with respect to prevention programs to include abstinence from sexual activity, providing family planning services, fostering academic achievement, mentoring by adults, providing employment assistance or job training, providing professional counseling or peer counseling, providing for recreational or social events, and any of its combination; and the term \"prevention  program\" as a program for the prevention of pregnancy in adolescents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING LABELING REQUIREMENTS FOR FOODS WHICH CONTAIN SATURATED FAT AND CHOLESTEROL
rows.title_short: Low Cholesterol Consumer Education Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Low Cholesterol Consumer Education Act of 2008.\" Enforces compulsory labeling and fair packaging thus expressly requiring information on the fat and cholesterol contents of food products to enable the consumer to obtain accurate information as to the nature, quality and quantity of its contents to facilitate the comparison of the value of such products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT LIMITING THE EXPOSURE OF CHILDREN TO VIOLENT PROGRAMMING ON TELEVISION AND CABLE SYSTEMS
rows.title_short: Children's Media Protection Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Children's Media Protection Act of 2008.\" Seeks to authorize the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) and the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) to prescribe ratings for violent television programming and rules for blocking such violent programming in apparatuses with such technical capability to allay the apprehentions that there is an irrefutable connection between the amount of violence depicted in television programs being watched by children and the increased aggression among these children.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A NATIONAL WOMEN'S BUSINESS ENTERPRISE POLICY AND PRESCRIBING ARRANGEMENTS FOR DEVELOPING, COORDINATING AND IMPLEMENTING A NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR WOMEN'S ENTERPRISE
rows.title_short: Women's Business Enterprise Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Women's Business Enterprise Act of 2008.\" Seeks to empower women in the business enterprise by developing a national program and creating an interagency committee on women's business enterprise thus giving them opportunities that will enhance their welfare and realize their full potential in the service of the nation.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2009-06-03

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ORDAINING INSTITUTIONAL RESPONSIBILITY IN GIVING TESTIMONY IN CRIMINAL CASES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS
rows.abstract: Penalizes any law enforcement officer or public employee working for a law enforcement or related agency, who, after due notice, fails or refuses, intentionally or negligently, to appear either as a prosecution or defense witness in any criminal proceedings, without any valid reason. Further punishes the head of office or agency for failure to exert effort to present his subordinate.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING INTERNET GAMBLING
rows.title_short: Internet Gambling Prohibition Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Internet Gambling Prohibition Act of 2008.\" Prohibits internet gambling in the country to protect the citizens from the cheats preying on people easily lured by the promises of beautiful gifts and large amounts of money.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GAMES AND AMUSEMENTS since 2008-12-15

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386, ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE, ARTICLE 1403, ON THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS REGARDING AGREEMENTS FOR THE SALE OF GOODS, CHATTELS, OR THINGS IN ACTION
rows.abstract: Seeks to increase the required amount of payment for the agreement for the sale of goods, chattels or things in auction from five hundred (P500.00) pesos to ten thousand (P10,000.00) pesos to comply with demands of time.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-12-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING THE VNHS-CANUMAY EAST ANNEX IN BARANGAY CANUMAY, CITY OF VALENZUELA, METRO MANILA, FROM THE VALENZUELA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING IT INTO AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, TO BE KNOWN AS THE CANUMAY EAST NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-12-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING CERTAIN LANDS OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN, LOCATED IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF BANTAYAN, DAANBANTAYAN, MADRIDEJOS AND STA. FE, PROVINCE OF CEBU, AS AGRICULTURAL LAND FOR AGRICULTURAL, COMMERCIAL, RESIDENTIAL, TOURISM AND OTHER SIMILAR PRODUCTIVE PURPOSES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL PROCLAMATION NO. 2151, \"DECLARING CERTAIN ISLANDS AND/OR PARTS OF THE COUNTRY AS WILDERNESS AREAS,\" DATED DECEMBER 29, 1981, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_short: Authorizing The Issuance Of Free Patent Title For Residential Land
rows.abstract: Authorizes the issuance of a free patent to lands that have been zoned as residential area provided that the applicant has actually resided on and continually occupied the land applied for for at least ten (10) years.

rows.author: E062
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN AND ENHANCE THE USE OF ENGLISH AS THE MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION IN THE PHILIPPINE SCHOOLS
rows.title_short: Strengthening And Enhancing The Use Of English As The Medium Of Instruction Act
rows.abstract: Aims to correct the defects of the current Bilingual Education Program of the Department of Education (DepEd) with its ultimate objective of improving the learning process in schools to ensure quality outputs; aims to raise to a higher level the English language proficiency of Filipino students and graduates of our educational system in line with the demands of business and industries to be competitive in the business world; and, seeks to step up the level of English language proficiency or the ability to communicate in the world of economic enterprise as the key for Filipino graduates to get better jobs here and overseas considering that English is the language of research, engineering, science and technology and other areas which is an accepted practice in global business and employment.
rows.status: Unfinished Business (Period of Sponsorship)

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE MINDANAO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (MEDA), DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Mindanao Economic Development Authority (meda) Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Mindanao Economic Development Authority (MEDA) Act of 2008.\" Seeks to strengthen the Mindanao Economic Development Council (MEDCo) by converting it into an Authority in order to preserve, protect and strengthen the gains achieved thus far from the peace and development efforts in Mindanao as well as to establish a permanent mechanism that will ensure coherence, consistency and continuity of development efforts in the island-region.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06958

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING COMPULSORY WELFARE INSURANCE PROGRAM FOR ALL OVERSEAS CONTRACT WORKERS
rows.title_short: Overseas Contract Workers Insurance Act
rows.abstract: \"Overseas Contract Workers Insurance Act.\" Seeks to protect and ensure the welfare of the Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) by providing them compulsory welfare insurance program in addition to the benefits being provided by the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 544, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CIVIL ENGINEERING LAW, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Seeks to attune the existing Civil Engineering Law to national development needs; strengthen the profession and enable civil engineers to cope with the formidable challenges brought about by globalization and cross-boarder practice, and; continually upgrade the level of competence of the civil engineers through: peer recognition of specialization, continuous professional development, and strengthening of the accredited professional organization of civil engineers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2008-12-17

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE RESETTLEMENT, AID AND REHABILITATION SERVICES FOR THE UNDERPRIVILEGED AND HOMELESS CITIZENS AFFECTED BY THE DEMOLITION OF HOUSES/DWELLINGS ALONG DANGER AREAS SUCH AS ESTEROS, GARBAGE DUMPS, RIVERBANKS, SHORELINES, WATERWAYS, AND OTHER PUBLIC PLACES SUCH AS SIDEWALKS, ROADS, PARKS, AND PLAYGROUNDS AS WELL AS THE VICTIMS OF DISASTERS AND CALAMITIES AND THOSE AFFECTED BY GOVERNMENT INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS IN METRO MANILA AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Resettlement, Aid And Rehabilitation Services For The Underprivileged And Homeless Citizens Affected By The Demolition Of Houses/dwellings Along Danger Areas
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide resettlement of some 126,320 families that are expected to be displaced by demolitions and clearing operations in Metro Manila as well as to some 12,082 families that will be affected by government infrastructure projects through the establishment of resettlement centers, home sites, or town sites, whether off-site or beneficiary-led, through the Community Mortgage Program (CMP) or other socialized housing programs, and; seeks to provide a permanent solution to the problem of the informal settlers in Metro Manila and restore the lives of the underprivileged and homeless citizens who suffer damages resulting from the demolition in or the clearing up of danger areas and other public places as well as victims of disasters and calamities and those affected by government infrastructure projects in Metro Manila.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2009-01-26, transmitted to on 2009-01-29 and received by the Senate on 2009-01-29

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT REDUCING THE RATE OF AMUSEMENT TAX TO BE COLLECTED FROM THE PROPRIETORS, LESSEES, OR OPERATORS OF THEATERS OR CINEMAS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 140 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.title_short: Reducing The Rate Of Amusement Tax To Be Collected From The Proprietors, Lessees, Or Operators Of Theaters Or Cinemas
rows.abstract: Seeks to amend Section 140 (A) of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code in order to encourage the growth and development of the entertainment industry that had deteriorated due to the imposition of a higher amusement tax; help the proprietors, lessees and operators, and encourage more investments and innovations on the entertainment industry, and; produce quality films that are culturally, politically and economically beneficial to the Filipino people.
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT RA09640 (Lapsed into law on 2009-05-21)

rows.author: F096
rows.title_full: AN ACT LIMITING EXPOSURE OF CHILDREN TO VIOLENT AND OBSCENE PROGRAMMING ON TELEVISION AND CABLE SYSTEMS
rows.title_short: Children's Media Protection Act
rows.abstract: \"Children's Media Protection Act.\" Prescribes television violence rating codes for children and prohibits violent programming on television during certain hours.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-02-17

rows.author: F096
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS TO MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND THEIR CHILDREN
rows.title_short: Scholarship Grants For Members Of The Armed Forces
rows.abstract: \"Scholarship Grants for Members of the Armed Forces.\" The bill grants scholarship grants in state-run universities and colleges and in public schools to children of members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F096
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS TO PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS AND THEIR CHILDREN
rows.title_short: Scholarship Grants To Public School Teachers And Their Children Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Scholarship Grants to Public School Teachers and Their Children Act of 2008.\" The bill provides public school teachers in active service and tbeir legitimate children free education in the elementary, high school and college levels in any public school and state university and college.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F096
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS TO MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE AND THEIR CHILDREN
rows.title_short: Scholarship Grants For Members Of The Philippine National Police And Their Children Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Scholarship Grants for Members of the Philippine National Police and their Children Act of 2008.\" The bill provides active members of the PNP and their legitimate children free education in the elementary, high school and college levels in any public school and state university and college.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CITIES AND MUNICIPALITIES TO LEVY TAXES ON SAND, GRAVEL AND OTHER QUARRY RESOURCES AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 138 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7160 ALSO KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill shifts the power to levy taxes on sand, gravel and other quarry resources from the province to the city or municipality concerned where the quarry is located and further provides for efficient monitoring by authorizing barangay officials where the quarry is located to monitor the activities of quarry operators.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-12-17

principal_referral.committee: MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE CERTAIN DISCLOSURES RELATING TO MATERIALLY ALTERED FILMS
rows.title_short: Film Disclosure Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Film Disclosure Act of 2008.\" Declares it a policy of the state to protect and secure the rights of scientists, inventors, artists, and other gifted citizens to their intellectual property and creations, thus requiring that each public exhibition of a materially altered motion picture, and each copy of a materially altered motion picture offered to the public through sale or lease (including its film packaging), shall include a label which clearly and conspicuously discloses certain information.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING WHO ARE INSTITUTIONALIZED PERSONS AND PENALIZING THEIR MALTREATMENT
rows.title_short: Institutionalized Persons Protection Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Institutionalized Persons Protection Act of 2008.\" Declares it a policy of the state to provide adequate social services to institutionalized persons and to respect their dignity by ensuring that the persons in charge of their care and maintenance treat them properly.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT CHILDREN FROM FOODS THAT POSE A SIGNIFICANT CHOKING HAZARD
rows.title_short: Food Choking Prevention Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Food Choking Prevention Act of 2008.\" Seeks for the placement of mandatory warning labels on statistically dangerous foods to protect the children from choking hazard. Defines \"choking\" as the condition caused by blocking the airways to the lungs, as with food or swelling of the larynx.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on THE WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT CONSUMERS BY PROMULGATING UNIFORM MANUFACTURING STANDARDS FOR BICYCLE HELMETS AND PROMOTING ITS USE
rows.title_short: The Bicycle Helmet Safety Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"The Bicycle Helmet Safety Act of 2008.\" Provides for the mandatory use of approved bicycle helmets thereby mandating government offices authorized to prescribe uniform standards in the manufacture of such helmets and further authorizes the Department of Transportation and Communication to establish grants for programs that require or encourage individuals to wear approved bicycle helmets.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2008-12-16)

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO CRIMINALIZE INTERNET SCAMS INVOLVING FRAUDULENTLY OBTAINING PERSONAL INFORMATION
rows.title_short: Anti-phising Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Phising Act of 2008.\" Defines the term \"phising\" to mean as an internet scam based on misleading or false communications that trick the user into sending money, or trick the user into revealing enough information to enable various forms of identity theft that result in financial loss and thereby criminalizes such internet scam.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 14 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7166, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"SYNCHRONIZED ELECTION LAW OF 1991\", ON THE PARTICULAR OFFICE WHERE CANDIDATES SHALL FILE THEIR STATEMENTS OF ELECTION CONTRIBUTIONS AND EXPENDITURES AND PROVIDING ADMINISTRATIVE SANCTIONS FOR VIOLATIONS OF SAID SECTION
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to designate the particular Commission of Elections (COMELEC) office where the statement of expenditures and constributions in connection with the election are to be filed. It further seeks to correct the flaw in the existing law whereby the provisions decriminalize only the failure to declare election expenses while failure to file statements of election contributions by the contributor required is still classified as an election offense. Furthermore, it proposes that all violations of the provisions concerning electoral contributions and expenditures be penalized administratively.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO COMBAT ABUSE AND INCREASE PENALTIES FOR CRIMES AGAINST SENIORS
rows.title_short: Senior's Safety Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Senior's Safety Act of 2008.\" Seeks to develop strategies for preventing and punishing crimes that target or otherwise disproportionately affect seniors by collecting appropriate data to measure the extent of crimes committed against them.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-12-17

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR RESTRICTIONS ON GARNISHMENT OF COMPENSATION DUE FOR PERSONAL SERVICES
rows.title_short: Restrictions On Garnishment Of Compensation Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Restrictions on Garnishment of Compensation Act of 2008.\" Defines \"garnishment\" to mean any legal or equitable procedure through which the earnings of any individual are required to be withheld for payment of any debt. This bill seeks to abate if not eliminate the use unrestricted garnishment or deduction from the compensation of employees which encourages liberal extension of credit by unscrupulous parties which sometimes result in loss of employment by the debtors resulting in the disruption of employment, production, and compensation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2008-12-17

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE CENTRAL VISAYAS STATE COLLEGE OF AGRICULTURE, FORESTRY AND TECHNOLOGY, ITS UNITS AND SATELLITE CAMPUSES IN THE CITY OF TAGBILARAN AND IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF BILAR, CANDIJAY, CLARIN, CALAPE AND BALILIHAN, ALL LOCATED IN THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE BOHOL ISLAND STATE UNIVERSITY (BISU), AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Converting The Central Visayas State College Of Agriculture, Forestry And Technology, Its Units And Satellite Campuses In The City Of Tagbilaran And In The Municipalities Of Bilar, Candijay, Clarin, Calape And Balilihan, All Located In The Province Of Bohol To Be Known As The Bohol Island State University
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09722) enacted on 2009-10-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING TITLE 1, CHAPTER 1, SECTION 12 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, REQUIRING APPLICANTS FOR A MARRIAGE LICENSE TO PRESENT THEIR CERTIFICATES OF NON-MARRIAGE TO THE LOCAL CIVIL REGISTRAR, IN ADDITION TO THE OTHER DOCUMENTS REQUIRED THEREIN TO BE PRESENTED
rows.abstract: Seeks to further strengthen the institution of marriage and put into law what has already been regularly done in actual practice by authorities to avoid injury to the public particularly in cases of unwittingly contracted bigamous marriages.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN LOCAL OFFICIALS FROM FILLING THE VACANCY IN THE OFFICES OF THE GOVERNOR, VICE-GOVERNOR, MAYOR OR VICE-MAYOR, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 44 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO, 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386, ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE, ARTICLE 781, ON THE GROUND OF SUPERFLUITY
rows.abstract: Repeals Article 781 of the Civil Code, which states that: \"The inheritance of a person includes not only the property and the transmissible rights and obligations existing at the time of his death but also those which have accrued thereto since the opening of the succession,\" on the ground of superfluity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADDRESSING THE SYSTEM OF PROSTITUTION, IMPOSING PENALTIES ON ITS PERPETRATORS, PROVIDING PROTECTIVE MEASURES AND SUPPORT SERVICES FOR ITS VICTIMS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLES 202 AND 341 OF THE PENAL CODE
rows.title_short: The Anti-prostitution Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"The Anti-Prostitution Act of 2008.\" Seeks to shift accountability about prostitution from the prostituted person to the exploiters -- the traffickers, the primps, the brothel owners, the organized crime members, and the corrupt officials.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2010-01-20

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2010-01-20

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION ONE OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED AND SIXTY-NINE, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CHARTER OF THE PHILIPPINE CHARITY SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE
rows.abstract: Seeks to remove from the Philippine Charity Sweeptakes Office (PSCO) the authority to conduct lotteries or other similar activities, in collaboration, association, or joint venture with any person, association, company, or entity, whether domestic or foreign, including any arrangement that bears an identifiable resemblance to the existing Equipment Lease Agreement (ELA).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF BETRAYAL OF DUTY IN THE CUSTODY OF PRISONERS PROVIDING FOR ADDITIONAL RULES ON THE IMPRISONMENT, DETENTION, CONFINEMENT AND CUSTODY OF PRISONERS AND DETAINEES, SPECIFYING ADDITIONAL WORK AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL CHARGED WITH THE CUSTODY OF SUCH PRISONERS AND STATING THE PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to impose stiffer penalty to government officials or employees who desecrates their duty as caretakers of detention prisoners as dictated by the necessity that the penalty of the crime of infedility of a custodian be made in proportion to the gravity of the crime of the illegally freed offenders.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE WAIVER OF THE RETIREMENT AGE REQUIREMENT OF GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WHO HAVE RENDERED AT LEAST TWENTY (20)YEARS OF SERVICE, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO, 1146, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT OF 1977
rows.abstract: Seeks to allow government employees to retire after serving the government for a period of twenty (20) years, regardless of the retirement age requirement under existing retirement laws.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE THE PHILIPPINE INSTITUTE OF VOLCANOLOGY AND SEISMOLOGY (PHILVOCS) AND THE PHILIPPINE ATMOSPHERIC GEOPHYSICAL AND ASTRONOMICAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION (PAGASA) TO ESTABLISH THE NATURAL CALAMITIES HAZARD MITIGATION PROGRAM

rows.abstract: “Calamities' Hazard Mitigation Program Act of 2008.” Establishes the Program for all coastal and insular areas in the country, to perform hazard assessment, monitoring and warning, and public education functions.
rows.status: Scheduled for first meeting/hearing on 2009-03-03

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INCLUDE IN THE CURRICULA OF ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOLS, COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES A COMPREHENSIVE COURSE ON ETHICS AND VALUES FORMATION
rows.title_short: Ethics And Values Formation Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Ethics and Values Formation Act of 2008.” Declares it a State policy to inculcate and strengthen the ethics and values of its citizen through the education system.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING OLD-AGE PENSION FOR LIFE TO SENIOR CITIZENS-RA 1616 RETIREES AS WELL AS SURVIVORSHIP BENEFITS TO THEIR SURVIVORS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF THE SECOND PARAGRAPH OF SECTION 12(c) OF COMMONWEALTH ACT 189, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Government Service Retirement Rationalization Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Government Service Retirement Rationalization Act of 2008.” Seeks to grant senior citizens-retirees, as well as retirees' survivors, upgraded benefits to be at par with the current rate enjoyed by those in actual government service thus providing them of decent standard of living and financial security they deserve.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2009-02-10

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT THE ESTABLISHMENT OF POLITICAL DYNASTIES
rows.title_short: The Anti-political Dynasty Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “The Anti-Political Dynasty Act of 2008.” Prohibits the spouse or any person related within the second degree of consanguinity or affinity, whether legitimate or illegitimate, full or half-blood to an incumbent elective official seeking re-election, to hold or run for any elective office in the same province in the same election.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 68, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CORPORATION CODE, SECTION 37, GRANTING STOCKHOLDERS THE RIGHT OF APPRAISAL WHEN THE TERM OF CORPORATE EXISTENCE IS EXTENDED
rows.abstract: Allows the stokeholders who dissent and vote against a proposed corporate action, to withdraw from the corporation demanding payment of the fair value of their shares, e.g., whenever a major change in their contracts of investment occur which they do not agree and which the law presumes they did not foresee when they bought their shares.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 337 OF THE PENAL CODE, ELIMINATING GENDER BIAS IN QUALIFIED SEDUCTION AND INCREASING THE IMPOSABLE PENALTY
rows.abstract: Seeks to remove the gender bias as to who may be the victim of qualified seduction by penalizing acts of qualified seduction committed against a person.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.mother_status: Printed copies distributed to members on 2009-12-01
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLES 333 AND 334 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE ON ADULTERY AND CONCUBINAGE

rows.status: Substituted by HB06811

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 32 OF R.A. NO. 7166 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE 1991 SYNCHRONIZED ELECTION LAW\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide reasonable remedy in the restrictive measure of prohibiting licensing of firearms during election period by allowing the Philippine National Police to continue to process and approve applications for license to possess firearms to qualified applicants.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094

rows.abstract: Seeks to strengthen the ranking system in the appointment of public School teachers by empowering the Local School Bords to screen and recommend applicants who posess the necessary qaulifications and standards, including the ranking system, set by the Department of Education, to any teaching position in their area of jurisdiction.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DETENTION OF LIVE OR DEAD PATIENTS IN HOSPITALS AND MEDICAL CLINICS ON GROUNDS OF NONPAYMENT OF HOSPITAL BILLS OR MEDICAL EXPENSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to allow live or dead patient to leave the hospital of medical clinic, with a right to demand the issuance of the corresponding medical certificate and other pertinent papers required for the release, upon execution of a promissory note covering unpaid obligation. States that the promissory note shall be secured by either a mortgage or by a guarantee of a co-maker who will be jointly and severally liable with the patient for the unpaid obligation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS TO APPLY THE SHARE OF THE PROCEEDS DERIVED FROM THE DEVELOPMENT AND UTILIZATION OF HYDROTHERMAL, GEOTHERMAL, AND OTHER SOURCES OF ENERGY FOR ELECTRIFICATION OF OTHER AREAS WITHIN THE PROVINCE WHERE THE SOURCE OF ENERGY IS LOCATED, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 294 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Seeks to allow local government units (LUGs) to use the share of the proceeds derived from the development and utilization of various sources of energy by giving the LGUs reasonable discretion to tap any available sources of funding to enable them to collaborate with the national government in its programs for the benefit of the people, particularly in remote areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO UPGRADE THE POSITION OF SECRETARIES TO THE SANGGUNIAN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 469(A), OF CHAPTER 3, BOOK III, TITLE 5, ARTICLE I OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Seeks to elevate the position of secretary to the sanggunian with the rank and salary equal to a head of department or office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386, ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE, ARTICLE 1991, ON REPLACING THE WORD \"DEPOSITOR'S\" WITH \"DEPOSITORY'S\" IN ORDER FOR THE LAW TO REFLECT ITS INTENDED MEANING
rows.abstract: Seeks to replace the word “depositor's” with “depository's”  in order for the law to reflect its intended meaning by amending Article 1991 of Republic Act No. 386, otherwise known as the Civil Code of the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REDUCE AND PREVENT CHILDHOOD OBESITY BY ENCOURAGING SCHOOLS TO DEVELOP AND IMPLEMENT LOCAL, SCHOOL-BASED PROGRAMS DESIGNED TO REDUCE AND PREVENT CHILDHOOD OBESITY, PROMOTE INCREASED PHYSICAL ACTIVITY, AND IMPROVE NUTRITIONAL CHOICES
rows.title_short: Childhood Obesity Reduction Act
rows.abstract: “Childhood Obesity Reduction Act.” This bill seeks to reduce and prevent childhood obesity by encouraging schools todevelop and implement local, school-based programs designed to reduce and prevent childhood obesity, promote increased physical activity, and improve nutritional choices.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on THE WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO ALL BARANGAY OFFICIALS INCLUDING BARANGAY TANODS AND MEMBERS OF THE LUPONG TAGAPAMAYAPA, AND BARANGAY EMPLOYEES
rows.title_short: Barangay Incentives Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Barangay Incentives Act of 2008.” Seeks to grant exemption from income taxation the gross benefits received by barangay officials, including Barangay Tanods and members of the Lupong Tagapamayapa.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6948, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT STANDARDIZING AND UPGRADING THE BENEFITS FOR MILITARY VETERANS AND THEIR DEPENDENTS
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to increase the present benefits of the Filipino World War Veterans by increasing their monthly pension and at the same time providing them with medical assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on VETERANS AFFAIRS AND WELFARE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A FAIR AND EQUITABLE TERMS FOR THE RELEASE OF MEDICAL PRACTITIONERS' PROFESSIONAL FEES WITHHELD BY HOSPITALS OR MEDICAL CLINICS FOF FAILURE OF THE PATIENT TO PAY HOSPITAL BILLS ANBD PENALIZING VIOLATIONS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Medical Practitioners Protection Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Medical Practitioners Protection Act of 2008.” This bill seeks to afford protection to medical practitioners by curtailing the unjust practice of hospitals and medical clinics to withhold the payment of their professional fees pending full payment of patients' hospital bills.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING PUBLIC OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES FROM SMOKING WITHIN THE WORK PREMISES DURING OFFICIAL WORK HOURS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Public Officers And Employees Smoking Ban Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Public Officers and Employees Smoking Ban Act of 2008.” Penalizes the penalty of prision correccional or temporary disqualification from holding public office or both, at the discretion of the court, all public officers and employees guilty of smoking within the premises during office hours.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING PERSONS WHO MAY REGISTER AS VOTERS TO PRESENT ANY PROOF OF LEGAL RESIDENCE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8189, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE VOTERS REGISTRATION ACT OF 1996 AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to require the presentation of some proof of legal residence for the purpose of registration to be a voter to prevent the perennial problem of flying voters.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MANDATORY PERIOD TO RELOCATE SQUATTERS, GRANTING DISTURBANCE FEES TO OWNERS OF ILLEGALLY OCCUPIED RESIDENTIAL LAND, AND PENALIZING VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short: Landowners Protection Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Landowners Protection Act of 2008.” This bill seeks to provide equal protection to the squatters and to the landowners by providing a mandatory period in the relocation of squatters and compensating the landowners in case of failure of the local government unit concerned to act on the request for assistance to evict illegal occupants within the prescribed period thus giving full meaning to the noble objectives of RA 7279. It also further seeks to minimize, if not totally eliminate squatting because local government units will be compelled to monitor vacant lands to prevent trespassers from constructing illegal structures within their respective localities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE OPEN HIGH SCHOOL SYSTEM IN THE PHILIPPINES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: The Open High School System Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “The Open High School System Act of 2008.” The measure institutionalizes the open high school system which utilizes print, radio, television and computer-based communications, satellite broadcasting, teleconferencing and other multi-media learning and teaching technologies that allow students to study on their own without having to regularly attend classes in conventional classrooms. It establishes the system which shall be open to all youth and adults who have finished elementary education and to high school qualifiers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MODERNIZATION OF THE SCHOOL HEALTH AND NUTRITION PROGRAM (SHNP) OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, CULTURE AND SPORTS, AND AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: School Health And Nutrition Modernization Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “School Health and Nutrition Modernization Act of 2008.” Seeks to modernize and upgrade the School Health and Nutrition Program (SHNP) of the Department of Education which is designed to to promote, protect and maintain the health and nutritional well-being of the various sectors of elementary and secondary institutions, to maximize its contribution to quality basic education.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE CHARTER OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACADEMY(LGA), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990\", AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Local Government Academy (lga) Act Of 2007
rows.abstract: \"Local Government Academy (LGA) Act of 2007.\" This measure aims to strengthen the Local Government Academy (LGA) which is tasked to train and improve the managerial skills and technical capability of local government officials and personnel and transform it to a more autonomous corporate body with the end in view of making its program more responsive to the needs of its clients to properly equip them with the demands of their positions,
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING THE LOCAL SANGGUNIANS, EXCEPT THE SANGGUNIANG BARANGAYS, THE POWER TO CONDUCT INQUIRIES, IN AID OF LEGISLATION, TO ISSUE SUBPOENA AND TO PUNISH FOR CONTEMPT ANY PERSON WHO REFUSES TO OBEY SUCH PROCESS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 447, 458 AND 468 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill grants the local sanggunians the power to conduct inquiries in aid of legislation, to issue subpoena ad testificandum and subpoena duces tecum and to punish for contempt any person who refuses to obey the process.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF DRUG REHABILITATION CENTER IN EVERY REGION OF THE COUNTRY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This measure seeks to establish a drug rehabilitation center in every region in the country which will provide medical and psychiatric treatment to drug dependents, under the supervision of the Department of Health, thus providing these drug dependents an opportunity to become useful and productive members of the community again. Prescribes the functions and organizational structure of the center.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO MANDATE THE USE OF BIOFUELS IN THE TRANSPORT SECTOR, ESTABLISHING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL BIOFUEL PROGRAM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Biofuels Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Biofuels Act of 2008.” Seeks to mandate the use of bioethanol beginning at five per cent 5% within two (2) years from the effectivity of this Act at a minimum of ten per cent (10%) within four (4) years, and the use biodiesel at a minimum blend of one per cent (1%) and five per cent (5%) within two (2) to four (4) years.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT RECOGNIZING THE FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT OF ADULT PERSONS TO DECIDE THEIR OWN HEALTH CARE, INCLUDING THE DECISION TO HAVE LIFE-SUSTAINING TREATMENT WITHHELD OR WITHDRAW IN INSTANCES OF A TERMINAL CONDITION OR PERMANENT UNCONSCIOUS CONDITION
rows.title_short: Natural Death Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Natural Death Act of 2008.” Seeks to recognize the right of an adult person to make a written directive instructing his or her physician to withhold or withdraw life-sustaining treatment in the event of a terminal condition or permanent unconscious condition which shall be exercised by an authorized representative who validly holds his or her durable power of attorney for health.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH AS GRANT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE COMPREHENSIVE EYE EXAMINATIONS TO CHILDREN
rows.title_short: Children's Vision Improvement And Learning Readiness Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Children's Vision Improvement and Learning Readiness Act of 2008.” This bill aims to provide comprehensive eye examinations for children identified or considered at high risk of vision impairment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE REDUCTION OF ADOLESCENT PREGNANCY, HIV RATES, AND OTHER SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED DISEASES
rows.title_short: Family Life Education Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Family Life Education Act of 2008.” Seeks to provide a comprehensive sexuality education program with the end in view of reducing adolescent pregnancy, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS) rates and other sexually transmitted diseases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING AVAILABILITY OF HANDGUNS ONLY TO PERSONS WITH KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL IN THEIR SAFE USE, MAINTENANCE AND STORAGE
rows.title_short: Requirement Of Course Of Instruction In The Safe Use, Maintenance And Storage Of Handguns Act
rows.abstract: “Requirement of Course of Instruction in the Safe Use, Maintenance and Storage of Handguns Act.” Seeks to provide for an obligatory course of instruction on the safe use, maitenance and storage of handguns as a requisite for an individual to acquire a license to possess a handgun.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONCURRENCE OF THE LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD ON THE ASSIGNMENT OF DIVISION SUPERINTENDENTS, DISTRICT SUPERVISORS, SCHOOL PRINCIPALS, AND OTHER SCHOOL OFFICIALS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 99, PARAGRAPH (D) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Seeks to clarify the meaning of the provision in the Local Government Code regarding the concurrence of local school boards on the assignment of school officials so as to remove the various interpretations on the subject provision that caused some irritants among local officials and the Department of Education (DepEd) appointee.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO EMPOWER THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION (DEPED), THE COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION, (CHED), AND THE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (TESDA) TO REQUIRE ALL THE SCHOOL HEADS TO REPORT ALL THE INCIDENTS OF STUDENT SUICIDE IN THEIR RESPECTIVE SCHOOLS, WHETHER CONSUMMATED, FRUSTRATED, OR ATTEMPTED, AND TO PROVIDE A PROGRAM FOR STUDENT SUICIDE EARLY INTERVENTION AND PREVENTION
rows.title_short: Student Suicide Prevention Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Student Suicide Prevention Act of 2008.” Seeks to reduce, if not abate, the public health tragedy of student suicide which is linked to underlying academic oppression, by establishing prevention programs and early detection relating to such tragedy, thus making it a national policy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR POST-HARVEST FACILITIES AND APPROPRIATION OF  FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Post-harvest Facilities Support Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: “Post-Harvest Facilities Support Act of 2008.” Seeks to ensure that the farmers get the lion's share in thier off-farm income by providing them their own harvest facilities like warehouse and rice mill to be provided by the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2009-01-19

rows.author: F092
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT AND PENALIZE THE UNAUTHORIZED USE, POSSESSION, AND/OR CONTROL OF AUDIOVISUAL RECORDING DEVICES FOR THE UNAUTHORIZED RECORDING OF CINEMATOGRAPHIC FILMS AND OTHER AUDIOVISUAL WORKS AND/OR THEIR SOUNDTRACKS IN AN EXHIBITION FACILITY, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Anti-camcording Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Camcording Act of 2008.\" Defines the acts constituting unauthorized recording of cinematographic films, other audiovisual works and/or their sountracks in public exhibition/theatrical facilities which are contrary to the public interest, economic growth, and the intellectual property rights of the owners of these works.
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA10088) enacted on 2010-05-13

Report, if any; terminated the period of amendments; and approved the same on Second Reading.

republic_acts.title: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT AND PENALIZE THE UNAUTHORIZED USE, POSSESSION AND/OR CONTROL OF AUDIOVISUAL RECORDING DEVICES FOR THE UNAUTHORIZED RECORDING OF CINEMATOGRAPHIC FILMS AND OTHER AUDIOVISUAL WORKS AND/OR THEIR SOUNDTRACKS IN AN EXHIBITION FACILITY, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

republic_act.title: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT AND PENALIZE THE UNAUTHORIZED USE, POSSESSION AND/OR CONTROL OF AUDIOVISUAL RECORDING DEVICES FOR THE UNAUTHORIZED RECORDING OF CINEMATOGRAPHIC FILMS AND OTHER AUDIOVISUAL WORKS AND/OR THEIR SOUNDTRACKS IN AN EXHIBITION FACILITY, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_full: AN ACT CALLING FOR A CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION, PROVIDING FOR THE ELECTION OF ITS DELEGATES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to call a constitutional convention, provide for the election of seven (7) delegates from each region of the country and appropriate funds for the purpose. Provides that such election shall be held on the second Monday of May 2010.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06975

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2009-10-12
